# Temple Scroll Column 53 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 53 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**53:1** No Ammonite or Moabite shall ever be admitted to the assembly of the LORD, not even after ten generations — none of them shall ever be admitted,

**53:2** because they did not come to meet you with food and water when you were on your way out of Egypt, and because they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Mesopotamia to pronounce a curse on you.

**53:3** But the LORD your God refused to listen to Balaam. Instead, the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loves you.

**53:4** As long as you live, you must never promote their welfare or prosperity.

**53:5** Do not despise an Edomite, for he is your relative; do not despise an Egyptian, for you once lived as a foreigner in his country.

**53:6** The grandchildren of Edomites and Egyptians may be admitted to the assembly of the LORD.

**53:7** When you set up camp for war against your enemies, stay away from anything impure.

**53:8** If any man among you becomes ceremonially unclean because of a bodily emission during the night, he must leave the camp and stay outside.

**53:9** Toward evening he must wash himself with water, and after the sun sets he may return to the camp.

**53:10** Set aside a place outside the camp to be used as a latrine.

**53:11** Keep a digging tool with your equipment, and when you go outside to relieve yourself, dig a hole and cover up your waste.

**53:12** For the LORD your God is present with you in your camp, to protect you and to hand your enemies over to you. Your camp must therefore be holy, so that He does not see anything offensive among you and turn away from you.

**53:13** If a slave escapes from his master and comes to you for refuge, do not send him back.

**53:14** Let him live among you wherever he chooses, in whichever town he prefers. Do not mistreat him.

**53:15** No Israelite woman or man shall serve as a temple prostitute.

**53:16** You must never bring money earned through prostitution, or the earnings of a male prostitute, into the house of the LORD your God to fulfill any vow, for both are detestable to the LORD your God.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 53 presents Deuteronomy 23:3-18 as divine legislation. "Temple prostitute" for qedeshah/qadesh makes the cultic context clear. "Male prostitute" for "dog" — interpreting the likely referent for modern readers. "Ceremonially unclean" and "bodily emission" communicate the purity concepts accessibly.*
